claim: Single-agent systems exhibit more hallucination in tool parameters and incorrect tool choices compared to multi-agent collaboration.
falsifier: Compare tool use error rates between single-agent and multi-agent configurations on the same benchmark tasks.

conditions: tasks spanning travel, mortgage, and software development domains
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported system, task domains, LLM models, and experimental conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Single-agent architecture–hallucination in tool parameters principle
